title: The Jinx: The Life and Deaths of Robert Durst
description: In 2000, a tip leads a district attorney to re-open the investigation into the disappearance of Kathie Durst; investigators begin to focus on Durst's close friend, Susan Berman, a witness who was overlooked in 1982; Susan Berman is found murdered.

title: Real Time With Bill Maher
description: Acerbic comic Bill Maher welcomes a panel of guests from diverse parts of the political spectrum for a lively discussion of current events, as well as offering his own perspective on contemporary issues.

title: The Survivor
description: After being sent to Auschwitz, Haft is forced to participate in a gladiatorial boxing spectacle along with his fellow prisoners.

title: Elli and Her Monster Team
description: A homeless ghost seeking belonging at a Ghost Train draws unwanted outside attention, forcing her and its monster residents to embark on a quest to save their home and her chance at finding family.

title: Designing Christmas
description: Complicated and unexplored emotions may jeopardize everything between Stella and Pablo, co-hosts of a home renovation show, as they work together during the holidays.

title: Frankie Freako
description: After calling a late-night party hotline that promises out-of-this-world fun, uptight yuppie Conor Sweeney must battle the pint-sized forces of evil that get unleashed through his phone line, led by the maniacal rock 'n' roll goblin Frankie Freako.

title: A Big Fat Family Christmas
description: A photojournalist gets close to a co-worker as she shoots her family's annual holiday party for a cover story.

title: Alternate Endings: Six New Ways to Die in America
description: Six stories of people nearing death and of family members of the recently deceased who have chosen nontraditional end-of-life options and remembrances, from celebrations of life and living wakes, to green burials, extraterrestrial burials and more.

title: The Fever
description: After hearing a friend of hers rant about privilege and poverty, a rich woman (Vanessa Redgrave) completely oblivious to the world outside of her upscale urban lifestyle travels to a third-world country. Initially content to stick to the tourist area, the woman's worldview is shaken when a journalist (Michael Moore) shows her the devastated, war-torn majority of the country. When struck with a delirium-inducing fever in her hotel room, the woman reevaluates her understanding of life.

title: Class Divide
description: Filmmaker Marc Levin examines income inequality and gentrification in Chelsea, N.Y.

title: Grey Gardens
description: The lives of Edith Bouvier Beale (Jessica Lange) and her daughter Edie (Drew Barrymore), aunt and cousin of Jacqueline Kennedy Onassis.

title: Einstein and Eddington
description: Astrophysicist Arthur Eddington (David Tennant) supports Albert Einstein's (Andy Serkis) general theory of relativity.

title: From the Earth to the Moon
description: NASA assembles a group of astronauts for the Gemini program; the astronauts prepare by orbiting Earth.

title: From the Earth to the Moon
description: Apollo's first three astronauts are killed during a prelaunch test; the ship's designers scramble to save the lunar program.

title: From the Earth to the Moon
description: As film crew documents everything, the crew and the control team make their preparations for the first manned Apollo launch.

title: Euphoria
description: On New Year's Eve, old scores are settled, and new connections are made.

title: Euphoria
description: Jules questions Rue and Elliot's new friendship; Nate makes a tough decision; Kat's reality blurs as she ponders her relationship; Maddy contemplates ending her relationship.

title: Euphoria
description: Rue pursues a new business venture as she helps forge a friendship between Jules and Elliot.

title: Euphoria
description: Jules and Elliot grow closer; Maddy celebrates her birthday; Cal takes a trip down memory lane.

title: Deadwood: The Movie
description: Saloon owner Al Swearengen clashes with Sheriff Seth Bullock as the residents of Deadwood celebrate South Dakota's statehood in 1889.

title: The Insurrectionist Next Door
description: Alexandra Pelosi turns her camera on people who stormed the U.S. Capitol on January 6, 2021; through interviews conducted over two years, Pelosi talks to individuals charged with crimes for their participation in the unprecedented events of the day.

title: A Big Fat Family Christmas
description: A photojournalist gets close to a co-worker as she shoots her family's annual holiday party for a cover story.

title: Carrot Cake Murder: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
description: Much to the dismay of her fiancé, Hannah investigates the discovery of a skeleton found amid the rubble of a building that's undergoing renovation.

title: Christmas 9 to 5
description: Jennifer is a tough crime beat reporter who gets the assignment of her life: to find the true meaning of Christmas.

title: A Dangerous Son
description: Although parents of children who have serious mental illnesses struggle to find appropriate treatment before their children harm themselves or others, they often face limited resources and support.

title: Simple as Water
description: Portraits of Syrian families displaced and fractured by war create a meditation on parental love that is both urgent and timeless.

title: Bury My Heart at Wounded Knee
description: In the 1880s, after the U. S. Army's defeat at the Battle of the Little Bighorn, the government continues to push Sioux Indians off their land. In Washington, D.C., Senator Henry Dawes introduces legislation to protect Native Americans' rights. Schoolteacher Elaine Goodale joins Sioux native and Western-educated Dr. Charles Eastman in South Dakota, working with tribe members. Meanwhile, Lakota Chief Sitting Bull refuses to give in to mounting government pressures.

title: Carrot Cake Murder: A Hannah Swensen Mystery
description: Much to the dismay of her fiancé, Hannah investigates the discovery of a skeleton found amid the rubble of a building that's undergoing renovation.

title: The Commandant's Shadow
description: Hans Jürgen Höss, the 87-year-old son of Rudolf Höss, as he faces his father's terrible legacy for the first time. His father was the camp commandant of Auschwitz and masterminded the murder of over a million Jews. While Hans Jürgen Höss enjoyed a happy childhood playing with many toys in the family villa at Auschwitz, Jewish cellist Anita Lasker-Wallfisch was playing for her life to survive the notorious concentration camp.
